summary: Iteration 11 tested the photo-based 'Calcola taglia da link' box (no height/weight/sex fields). CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: CalcolaTagliaBox.jsx had lost 7 useState declarations (working, result, needsFallback, reason, chartText, textLoading, importing), so /dashboard crashed with the runtime error 'working is not defined' and the whole page went blank. I re-added them and then all flows passed. Backend: 22/22 pytests passed (new tests/test_calcola_photo.py with 11 tests, plus test_auto_measure_encryption.py updated for the new saved-weight fallback). Covered: need_height 400 when no height is saved; the saved height is reused; precision is 75 without weight or gender, 88 with weight and no gender, 98 with gender; saved weight and gender are reused; forget_weight removes the weight (precision 85); height 100 gives 422; the photo is stored encrypted in db.files; 401 without auth. Frontend on the live URL: the box is white (rgb 255,255,255) with dark text (rgb 10,10,10); it has url-input, photo-btn, hidden photo-input, the exact help text and the CTA 'CALCOLA CON LA MIA FOTO'; there are no calcola-m-*, calcola-gender-* or ALTEZZA/PESO/SESSO labels. The no-URL and no-photo toasts send no API calls. Photo select, remove and change (file chooser) work. The saved-height user (fam_test) sees no height question; the CTA sends auto-measure (no height_cm) and then product/analyze, which gives calcola-fallback for the H&M test URL. A new user sees 'Quanto sei alto?'; height 90 gives a toast; 170 continues (auto-measure with height_cm=170, then analyze). GET measurements then returns height 170, gender null, precision 75. After a reload the question is not asked again. The garment photo gives the friendly toast 'Non vediamo bene la tua figura...' with no API call and no crash. Profile AutoMeasure: 'Preferisco non indicare il peso' sends forget_weight=true and gives 85%; with weight it gives 98%. Public '/' is still black with hero-logo /logo-white.png.

rca of the issue: Dashboard crash: during the refactor that removed the height/weight/sex fields, the useState lines for working/result/needsFallback/reason/chartText/textLoading/importing were deleted, but the JSX and handlers still referenced them. The render threw 'working is not defined' (CTA disabled={working}). Fix: re-declare the 7 states.
